html:
In August, the weather is gradually changing from summer to autumn, but this is also the time when Ha Long enters the cool weather, very suitable for tourists’ outdoor excursions, so if you are planning to travel to Ha Long in August, let’s go through the points and experiences of traveling to Ha Long right below with Vietlook.

The weather in Ha Long in August is relatively cool, the temperature fluctuates between 29 degrees Celsius – 30 degrees Celsius, however, in August Ha Long has sudden showers so you should bring an umbrella so as not to affect the sightseeing journey of tourists, because the showers are usually short and not too long so they do not affect the tourists’ tour.

Ha Long tourist attractions in August

Bai Tho Mountain

Located at an altitude of 200m above sea level, and right next to Ha Long city, where nature has bestowed poetic beauty, from the top of the mountain visitors can enjoy the whole beauty of the bay, especially in the autumn weather.

Tuan Chau Sculpture Park

The park is called King Kong Park, famous for its interesting games, besides the exquisite sculptures, visitors can also admire the waterfalls, which are an interesting stop every summer or weekend, especially for families with young children.

Ha Long Bay

As one of the indispensable destinations in the Ha Long tour itinerary, no matter what season of the year, Ha Long Bay always brings visitors a unique beauty. When coming here, visitors should visit Thien Cung Cave, Titop Island, Cua Van Fishing Village, Hang Luon, Hon Trong Mai, ….

Especially when visiting Ha Long Bay by cruise, sitting on the cruise, visitors can enjoy the whole beauty of the bay, a magical and poetic scene appears right before the eyes of visitors.

Titop Island

Located in the middle of Ha Long Bay, the island emerges like a crescent moon. Coming to the island, tourists can not only visit but also experience swimming, participate in games on the sea or conquer the top of the island to watch the beautiful sunset.

Sung Sot Cave

One of the pristine caves in Ha Long, inside the cave there are natural stalactites, a cool space, an ideal stopover in Ha Long.

Luon Cave

One of the most visited by tourists, especially foreign tourists, when they experience kayaking or bamboo boats deep inside to admire the beauty of the cave, from inside the cave visitors can admire the beauty of the curved stone arch, when the sun shines down, creating a beautiful scene, a destination for tourists who love nature.

Cuu Van Fishing Village

Hidden next to the sea, a small fishing village lies under the cool green coconut trees, with boats anchored next to the casuarina trees, every evening the scene of the fishing village is bustling with boats coming to shore, with gentle smiles, when the dawn comes, those boats follow each other to go out to sea, looking like a poetic picture of the sea and islands.

In addition, when traveling to Ha Long in August, visitors should participate in interesting games on the sea such as: kayaking, sleeping overnight on a boat, experiencing Ha Long by seaplane … all will bring visitors the most interesting vacation when coming to Ha Long.

Delicious dishes you should try when traveling to Ha Long in August such as: Ngan Bien, Cha Muc, Sam Bien, Tien Yen Hill Chicken, Bun Be Man… and many more delicious and attractive dishes are waiting for tourists to discover.

With the experiences of traveling to Ha Long in August that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, you probably have your own answer, and will no longer wonder what is beautiful about traveling to Ha Long in August, wish you a happy trip.
